purpose: Writes a zip file of stored (uncompressed) files with the same bytes every time, and reads one back with every checksum checked.

host.replaces: run-8 app/src/services/zip.ts: zipStore (entries named data, now bytes)
run-8 app/src/services/zip.ts: zipList (names, sizes and crc only; now the bytes too, with the crc checked)

library.title: Zip file (write stored files, read them back)
library.note: Pure bytes in, bytes out, no DOM and no React: zipStore packs named files into a zip with no compression, UTF-8 names and a fixed date so the same input gives the same bytes; unzipStore reads the files back and checks each checksum; crc32. It refuses unsafe names (empty, leading /, .. parts, repeats) and anything over 4 GiB. A zip with deflate inside is refused by name of the method; for compressed zips take a library. Also found as: zip file; make a zip; pack files into an archive; unzip; read a zip; export as zip.
